content.text:
Create an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a skateboard

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.9.6 (standard library only), node 26.11.1 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep any code you write to make the files (it's published as the source), but delete
  intermediate files such as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p output && cat > output/pelican.svg <<'E'
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300">
<rect width="400" height="300" fill="#bfe6ff"/>
<circle cx="340" cy="50" r="28" fill="#ffe27a"/>
<rect y="235" width="400" height="65" fill="#8c8c96"/>
<rect y="235" width="400" height="5" fill="#6d6d77"/>
<!-- skateboard -->
<path d="M85 222 Q75 215 82 210 L318 210 Q325 215 315 222 Z" fill="#d9472b"/>
<circle cx="130" cy="232" r="11" fill="#333"/><circle cx="130" cy="232" r="4" fill="#ddd"/>
<circle cx="272" cy="232" r="11" fill="#333"/><circle cx="272" cy="232" r="4" fill="#ddd"/>
<!-- legs -->
<path d="M180 168 L172 205 M222 168 L228 205" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M160 208 h26 M216 208 h28" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<!-- tail -->
<path d="M165 150 L120 168 L172 172 Z" fill="#e8e8e8" stroke="#999"/>
<!-- body -->
<ellipse cx="205" cy="140" rx="55" ry="38" fill="#f4f4f4" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M175 135 Q205 160 245 125 Q215 110 175 135Z" fill="#dcdcdc"/>
<!-- neck & head -->
<path d="M240 125 Q275 110 262 80 Q255 62 272 55" stroke="#f4f4f4" stroke-width="18" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<circle cx="275" cy="55" r="19" fill="#f4f4f4" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
<!-- beak -->
<path d="M290 50 L368 66 Q330 70 291 66 Z" fill="#f5a623" stroke="#c77d0a" stroke-width="2"/>
<path d="M291 66 Q325 98 365 68 Q330 72 291 66Z" fill="#e8920f"/>
<circle cx="281" cy="49" r="4" fill="#111"/><circle cx="282.5" cy="48" r="1.3" fill="#fff"/>
<!-- wing -->
<path d="M200 118 Q160 130 150 165 Q190 160 225 135Z" fill="#c9d3dc" stroke="#889" stroke-width="2"/>
</svg>
E

content.text:
I made an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a skateboard and saved it as `output/pelican.svg`. I haven't opened or rendered it, so I haven't checked how it looks.

It shows a white pelican with an orange beak, a wing and orange legs standing on a red skateboard. The board is on gray pavement under a light blue sky with a sun.
